hero.description: We bridge the gap between imagination and built reality through high-end visualization and immersive architectural storytelling.

processSection.label: Our Process
processSection.title: Where Narrative Meets Architecture
processSection.description: We don't just create images—we craft visual experiences that capture the essence of spaces before they exist. Every project is an exploration of light, emotion, and the poetry of built environments.
processSection.step1Desc: We begin by understanding the soul of your project—its purpose, emotion, and the story it needs to tell.
processSection.step2Desc: Every scene is crafted with cinematic lighting that evokes mood and draws viewers into the space.
processSection.step3Desc: Through subtle animation and camera movement, we breathe life into static architecture.
processSection.step4Desc: The result is a visual narrative that transcends traditional visualization—it's an experience.

services.label: What We Create
services.title: Services
services.description: We transform architectural concepts into compelling visual experiences that inspire and communicate.
services.archVizDesc: Photorealistic imagery that captures the essence of your design with stunning clarity and emotional depth.
services.animationDesc: Dynamic visual narratives that guide viewers through spaces, revealing atmosphere and experience.
services.virtualDesc: Immersive walkthroughs that transport clients into unbuilt environments with full spatial presence.
services.presentationDesc: Competition-ready visuals and presentations that communicate vision with impact and precision.

about.label: The Studio
about.title: PLANN3D Visual Studio
about.desc1: We are a creative studio dedicated to architectural visualization, animation, and immersive visual experiences. Our work lives at the intersection of art and architecture.
about.desc2: Every project begins with a question: What should this space make people feel? From there, we explore narrative, light, movement, and atmosphere to create visuals that transcend documentation and become genuine experiences.
about.desc3: Based in the creative heart of contemporary design, we collaborate with architects, developers, and visionaries worldwide to bring unbuilt environments to life.

contactSection.label: Get in Touch
contactSection.title: Let's Create Something
contactSection.description: Ready to transform your architectural vision into a compelling visual narrative? We'd love to hear about your project.

footer.description: A high-end visualization studio dedicated to crafting cinematic stories for the built environment.

processPage.heroDesc: Concept, emotion, and realism. In architecture visualization we don't just render buildings, we create experiences.
processPage.sparkDesc: We start in the abstract. Seeking the soul of the space, its ambitions and intentions. Before a single polygon is modeled, we understand the narrative.
processPage.earlyConceptCaption: Early concept → Vertex Tower → Zurich, Switzerland
processPage.structureDesc: Precision in every polygon. Building the digital reality from the ground up. We obsess over topology and form to ensure the foundation is flawless.
processPage.lightDesc: Light defines emotion and form. We paint with shadows and exposure.
processPage.atmosphereDesc: The interplay between light and shadow creates depth, warmth, and emotion that transforms visualization into experience.
processPage.realityDesc: The final render: a synthesis of technical precision and artistic vision. Spaces that exist only in imagination come alive with photorealistic clarity.
processPage.ctaDesc: Let's turn your ideas into stunning visual narratives. Reach out to start your project.

studioPage.label: The Studio
studioPage.heroDesc: We are a creative studio dedicated to architectural visualization, animation, and immersive visual experiences. Our work lives at the intersection of art and architecture.
studioPage.philosophyDesc1: Every project begins with a question: What should this space make people feel? From there, we explore narrative, light, movement, and atmosphere to create visuals that transcend documentation.
studioPage.philosophyDesc2: We don't just show buildings—we create experiences. The way morning light filters through a window, how shadows dance across a courtyard, the warmth of materials in afternoon sun. These moments are what we capture.
studioPage.philosophyDesc3: Based in the creative heart of contemporary design, we collaborate with architects, developers, and visionaries worldwide to bring unbuilt environments to life.
studioPage.visionFirstDesc: Every project starts with understanding the emotional impact you want to create.
studioPage.collaborationDesc: We work alongside architects and developers as creative partners, not vendors.
studioPage.excellenceDesc: We obsess over every pixel, every shadow, every reflection until it's perfect.
studioPage.globalReachDesc: Working with visionaries across Brazil, bringing diverse perspectives.
studioPage.teamDesc: Artists, architects, and technologists united by a passion for visual storytelling.
studioPage.recognitionDesc: Our work has been recognized by leading organizations in architecture and visualization, reflecting our commitment to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
studioPage.ctaDesc: Have a vision? Let's bring it to life. Reach out to discuss your next project.

contactPage.label: Contact Us
contactPage.description: Ready to visualize your vision? Whether it's high-end architectural rendering or immersive VR experiences, let's build something iconic together.
